The bow, both hands, bird head, full tail and both clawed feet all fit in frame with generous transparent margins. Polished hand-painted 3D strategy-game art, broad readable shapes, slightly elevated three-quarter front view, warm edge lighting and cool fill. Rider and mount form one coherent unit, strong silhouette legible at small size. Genuine transparent alpha background; no ground, floor, pedestal, cast shadow, scenery, text, UI, border, watermark, extra characters or detached effects. An original reinterpretation for a science-fantasy auto-chess game.
